name: AMD Instinct MI355X

sources.title: Glenn Lockwood: MI355X notes (quotes the AMD MI355X brochure)

summary: CDNA 4 OAM accelerator with 288 GB HBM3E. Ships in liquid-cooled racks and in air-cooled 8-GPU servers such as Supermicro's 10U AS-A126GS-TNMR. Compute figures are dense matrix peaks.

tdpW.note: 1,400 W maximum total board power, as quoted from AMD's MI355X brochure. amd.com timed out when fetched, so the secondary source is cited.

fp8Pflops.note: Dense matrix FP8 (5,033 TFLOPS), from AMD's brochure via the cited notes.

fp4Pflops.note: Dense matrix MXFP4 (10,066 TFLOPS), from AMD's brochure via the cited notes.

hbmGb.note: 288 GB HBM3E, from AMD's brochure via the cited notes.
